core_obligations: (1)=>(2): completion of an etale local homomorphism is etale on completions: reduce to flatness plus the accepted unramified-completions characterization (parts (1)-(3) of this chapter).
(2)=>(3): A^ -> B^ is local, so etale as a local homomorphism follows from etale as a homomorphism (standard-prime transfer, argued via faithful flatness of the completion).

(3)=>(1): B^ etale over A^ => flat; faithful flatness of the completion identifies flatness of A -> B with flatness of A^ -> B^ (argued); then B essentially of finite type + flat + the unramified transfer via the accepted pair gives (1).
Finally B^ finite over A^ and flat => finite free as A^-module by the in-source finite-flat-free section.
proof_roadmap: flatness equivalence via faithful flatness of completion (argued) + accepted unramified-completions pair + in-source finite-flat=>free.
difficulty_reason: Reduces to flatness equivalence via faithful flatness of the completion (argued), uses the accepted unramified-completions pair, finite flat implies free via the in-source section.
